That electronic table has FOUR money columns (Total this Period / YTD / Total this Period Other Campaign Accounts / YTD Other Campaign Accounts); Column A is mapped from 'Total this Period' and Column B from 'YTD'. Both 'Other Campaign Accounts' columns print $0.00 on lines 1 and 2 and are not captured. The form prints 'Report: Interim Report' even though the bundle is a dissolution - the FORM FACE is recorded.
